name: Virginia
source:
Amicus and Cassius's older sister.

[spoiler]Privately supports Amicus' claim to the throne so that she can be his chief advisor - a position of such power that no Adastran woman has ever held. Secretly works with Neferu, and later Marco, in Amicus' interest.[/spoiler]
